entries.target: An infinite range attack that deals damage to 3 hostile targets.
entries.officialDescription: Fires long range bolts infused with Void Energy dealing Moderate Damage enhanced by your Spell Power. Can hit up to three targets. Each bolt exposes their deepest sins dealing a Minor DoT for 3 seconds. Stacks to 6.

Description: Fires long range bolts infused with Void Energy dealing Moderate Damage enhanced by your Spell Power. Can hit up to three targets. entries.target: An infinite range status skill that applies to 1 target.
entries.officialDescription: Spreads it's wings and takes flight. Applies Vantage Point, increasing Hit Chance and Dodge by 15% for 6 seconds. Also allows you to focus all your fire on one target, empowering your arrows increasing your overall DoT Damage by 75%. Your focused targeting reduces the amount of void energy you need to expend, applying Mana Refraction which reduces mana costs by 50% for 8 seconds.
notes: Applies Vantage Point to caster for 6 seconds, increasing Hit Chance and Dodge by 15%, increasing DoT damage by 50%, and making all attacks single target.
Applies Mana Refraction to caster for 8 seconds, reducing mana costs by 50%.

entries.target: An infinite range attack that deals damage to 4 hostile targets.
entries.officialDescription: If Vantage Point is in play, you send shadow imgages striking up to 4 targets for Moderately Strong Damage. Applies Aghast, stunning the opponents for 3 seconds. If Vantage Point is not in play, applies Catalyst, siphoning their Haste, lowering it by 20% while maxing out your Haste for 8 seconds.
notes: If Vantage point is not active, applies Catalyst to caster for 8 seconds, increasing haste by 50%.
If Vantage point is not active, applies Catalyst to target enemies, lowering their haste by 20%.
If Vantage point is active, applies Aghast, stunning the target enemy for 3 seconds.
